draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.97, the 146th-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 12th of 17 at DE. He went 147th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Kerry Wynn. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 6 sacks in 2019, 10th of 17 DEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 7 pro, currently with the San Francisco 49ers. 34 career games and 1 starts over 6 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2025 against a career-best 1 in 2020. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (0th percentile). Played 4 of 17 games in 2025.
